text:
nina: Quick heads up 1: quant smoke w/ q4b dropped BLEU-like metric on the paraphrase bench; numbers look fine on q8x4.

paul: can you paste the diff? is it across the board or narrow?

nina: narrow. 180 prompts show -0.15 absolute vs q8x4, majority are near-duplicate paraphrase cluster items. snippet:
```
q8x4: 0.72
q4b: 0.57
example ids: p-3492, p-3601, p-3604 (near-duplicate paraphrase family)
```

maya: suspicious 1: our paraphrase ingest switched tokenizer version last week (tok-v2) which changed the fingerprint output. Could be golden contains duplicates or the q4b sensitivity to tokenization exacerbates it.

sam: Wait q8x4 less sensitive? quant artifacts differ. But if golden has duplicates, eval will artificially inflate or deflate scores depending on how duplicates are sampled.

labeler-bot: auto-report: sampled 250 of the failing 180 prompts; 210 have high anchor-similarity to existing golden anchors when re-hashed with `tok-v1` (sim>0.92). Current ingest used `tok-v2` and flagged as unique.

paul: That matches the hypothesis. Looks like golden refresh included those new "uniques" so eval set has a bunch of near-duplicates. For q4b small token misalignment can change completions more than q8x4.

nina: Proposed immediate steps:
1) Pause quant smoke rollout for q4b (don't merge the perf flag).
2) Run rehash of the paraphrase candidate batches with tok-v1 to produce canonical anchors.
3) Diff current golden vs rehashed anchors and remove contested items from eval/golden snapshot.
4) Re-run smoke after golden prune.

maya: I can run the rehash job. Command I plan to use:
```
GIT_TAG=ingest/tokenizer@v1.4.2
python -m ingest.rehash --input s3://ingest/paraphrase/2027-03 --tokenizer-tag $GIT_TAG --out s3://ingest/paraphrase/2027-03-rehashed
```

sam: Also add a short preflight: before any golden-refresh, compare fingerprint distribution KL against the last snapshot. If KL>0.02 block the job and send alert.

deploy-bot: rollback gate applied: quant/q4b smoke flagged STOP (reason: golden-contamination-detection). Manual approval required to proceed.

paul: We'll also need a migration plan so future tokenizer updates preserve anchor semantics. Idea: store normalized-fingerprint (tok-v1 canonical) alongside source text and mark tokenizer-tag used to create it. For new tokenizers, rehashing should be an automated migration step.

ops: Opening INC-2027-043 to track: "paraphrase ingest tokenizer -> golden contamination". Paging if blocked golden-refresh after hours.

labeler-bot: quarantined 3.6k contested golden candidates; labeler pool paused for those items.

nina: Who owns the golden prune? I can do the diff list but need final signoff from jen/ML leads. @sam can you coordinate signoff?

sam: I'll own signoff. Plan: once maya pushes rehash outputs, I'll run the diff script and produce a delete-list for golden-refresh. Then we'll snapshot current golden and apply prune in staging for QA.

paul: timeline estimate: rehash full set 90m, diff+prune 30m, staging QA 30m. We can aim to re-run smoke end-of-day if all goes well.

nina: OK thanks. Please post links to S3 outputs and INC ticket.

(last) ops: rehash started at 1811120200; rehash finished at 1811120445. Rehashed set: s3://ingest/paraphrase/2027-03-rehashed (3,625 contested items resolved to 1,200 uniques). INC-2027-043 updated with artifacts.
